Dear Hiring Manager,

Finlo's job post asks for someone who treats payment reliability as a product feature, and that's how I've worked for four years. At my current company I redesigned our caching layer and cut p95 latency by 40% — the kind of unglamorous work that makes a fintech feel trustworthy. I write Python the way your stack expects: typed, tested, and boring in the best way, with FastAPI and PostgreSQL in production since 2023.

I'd love to bring that bar to your platform team in Bengaluru.

Warm regards,
Shivam Gupta

Hi,

I applied for the Senior Backend Engineer role two weeks ago and wanted to check in. Since applying, I shipped a reconciliation service that now processes 2M events a day — very close to the problems your team describes. Happy to walk through the design if useful.

Is there anything else you need from my side?

Best,
Shivam

Dear Cartful team,

Marketplace infrastructure at your scale runs on queues that never lose an order. I've spent the last two years running Kafka in production — schema evolution, exactly-once consumers, the 3 a.m. rebalances — and I've learned Go well enough to respect its simplicity. Your posting for Backend Engineer II reads like a checklist of the problems I enjoy most.

I'd welcome a conversation.

Regards,
Shivam Gupta

Dear Hiring Manager,

Kettle Financial's Senior Software Engineer opening caught my eye because I've built the Java side of a payments stack before — Spring services, idempotent APIs, and audits that actually pass. I care about the details that keep money software dependable, and I move fast without breaking ledgers.

Sincerely,
Shivam Gupta

Hi,

Following up on my Data Engineer application from July 24. I recently migrated a reporting pipeline to BigQuery and cut its monthly cost by a third, which felt very relevant to your posting. I'd love ten minutes to discuss how I could help Nimbus.

Best,
Shivam

Dear Brightpath AI team,

I want to build the plumbing that makes LLM products reliable — batching, caching, fallbacks, evals. That's what your SDE II posting describes, and it's what I've been doing with Python for four years, most recently serving model inference behind a 40ms p95. I learn fast, measure everything, and ship.

Warm regards,
Shivam Gupta

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your Senior Backend Engineer posting is short on details but the stack is exactly mine: Python in Bengaluru, at scale. Four years in, I've owned services end to end — design, delivery, and the on-call that follows — and I hold a high bar for tests and observability.

I'd welcome the chance to learn more about the team.

Regards,
Shivam Gupta

Hi,

Checking in on my Senior Backend Engineer application from early August. I remain very interested — the role's Python focus matches my last four years of work. If the team is still reviewing, I'm happy to share code samples or references.

Best,
Shivam

Dear Loopwork team,

I've spent most of my career in Python, but the service I'm proudest of is a TypeScript GraphQL gateway that unified three legacy APIs — built remotely, shipped on time. Your Backend Developer role looks like more of that: pragmatic Node.js, clean contracts, remote trust.

Best regards,
Shivam Gupta

Dear Orbital Health team,

Healthcare software fails differently — quietly, and with consequences. Your Software Engineer posting's emphasis on HIPAA-grade Python systems matches how I like to build: defensive, audited, boring on purpose. Django has been my home base for years, and Chennai is family ground.

Sincerely,
Shivam Gupta

Dear Vantra Systems team,

I've been learning Rust nights and weekends for two years because distributed systems deserve a language that refuses to let you be sloppy. Professionally I've run gRPC services on Kubernetes at meaningful scale. Your Distributed Systems Engineer role is the intersection I've been working toward.

Regards,
Shivam Gupta

Hi,

Following up on my Distributed Systems Engineer application from mid-July. Since then I've open-sourced a small Raft implementation in Rust — it seemed like the most honest way to show interest. Link available on request.

Is the role still open?

Best,
Shivam

Hi,

I wanted to follow up on my Platform Engineer application. My recent work moving CI/CD onto GCP with Terraform mirrors your stack closely, and I'd be glad to talk through it. Thanks for your time!

Best,
Shivam

Dear Nimbus Analytics team,

Contract work suits how I operate: land, deliver, document, hand over. Your Data Engineer posting's Airflow-BigQuery-dbt stack is one I've run in production, including a migration that cut costs 33% while doubling daily model runs. I can be effective in week one.

Regards,
Shivam Gupta

Hi,

Following up on my application from earlier this summer — I know inboxes overflow. Still very interested and happy to provide anything that helps the decision.

Best,
Shivam

Dear Hiring Manager,

My four years of backend experience — Python, PostgreSQL, Kafka — line up well with the role, and I'd bring the same energy I bring to every team: high standards, low ego, fast feedback.

Regards,
Shivam Gupta
